offering_description.value: Provides hot-dip galvanizing and other metal coating services that protect steel from corrosion, and makes electrical and metal products such as conduit fittings and coated coil. Sells mainly to utilities, construction firms, industrial manufacturers and energy companies, largely through its own plants and direct sales.

primary_products.value: electrical conduit fittings; grounding products; coated steel coil; aluminum coil products

customer_segment.value: B2B: utilities, construction contractors, steel fabricators, industrial manufacturers, energy and transmission companies

end_markets.value: utilities; construction; industrial manufacturing; energy; telecommunications

revenue_model.value: service fees: galvanizing and coating processing charged per job for customers' steel; product sales: electrical fittings, conduit and coated coil sold to customers

value_chain_position.value: service provider: takes in customers' steel and applies protective metal coatings for a fee; OEM / manufacturer: makes electrical products and coated coil from purchased metal, sold to utilities and industrial buyers

geography_served.value: North America: galvanizing plants and customers across the United States, with operations in Canada

specialization.value: related lines: metal coating services, electrical products and engineered coil and metal materials that share steel and zinc processing

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated galvanizing and coating plants serving nearby customers; direct sales: sales teams selling directly to utilities, contractors and manufacturers; distributors / dealers: electrical distributors that resell conduit fittings and grounding products
distribution_channels.category: own locations; direct sales; distributors / dealers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: environmental and worker safety rules for zinc and coating plants, such as EPA air and water permits and OSHA

notes: Segment structure and product lists may have changed after recent reorganizations; details are based on general knowledge and may be incomplete.
